svg.text: F06 slave door and slave latch of the NAND flip-flops (same in DUT2, DUT3, DUT4)
clk high: the slave door passes mq (s1 = NOT mq, s2 = mq) and the slave latch copies it to q.
clk low: s1 = s2 = 1, the slave latch holds q while the master takes the next d.
Rails: VDD at the top, VSS at the bottom; every PMOS body is on VDD and every NMOS body on VSS (drawn inside the symbol). A dot marks a connection; wires that cross without a dot are not connected.
